items.q: What should you remember about **Mind-body unity is empirical**?
items.a: **Langer was among the first** to test mind-body claims with controlled studies, not just philosophy.

items.q: What should you remember about **Mindfulness ≠ meditation**?
items.a: **Noticing new things in the** present is the mechanism; meditation is one optional path to that state.

items.q: What should you remember about **When you don't know, you pay attention**?
items.a: **Certainty creates mindlessness; uncertainty opens perception and choice.**

items.q: What should you remember about **Three-new-things practice**?
items.a: **Notice three new things about someone you** live with, or on each walk; reveals how little you actually knew the "familiar.".

items.q: What should you remember about **Counterclockwise aging**?
items.a: **Environment + psychological framing** reversed multiple biological aging markers in under one week.

items.q: What should you remember about **Choices extend life**?
items.a: **Nursing-home residents given trivial autonomy** (movie Tuesday vs Thursday, own plant) lived longer at 18-month follow-up.

items.q: What should you remember about **Nocebo of hidden exercise**?
items.a: **Hotel workers already exercised but didn't *know*** it; reframing work as exercise changed BMI, waist-hip ratio, and blood pressure without behavior change.

items.q: What should you remember about **Placebo/nocebo are symmetric**?
items.a: **Poison ivy rash follows belief about** the leaf, not just chemistry; ipecac stops vomiting when labeled as anti-nausea.

items.q: What should you remember about **Healing follows expectations**?
items.a: **Doctor's stated recovery timeline organizes the body; "we don't know** — some heal in two weeks" preserves faster options.

items.q: What should you remember about **Vision follows expectation**?
items.a: **Snellen charts that shrink letters** prime failure; reversing expectation lets people read lines they couldn't before.

items.q: What should you remember about **Mindless checklists kill**?
items.a: **Air Florida**: warm-climate pilots ran anti-ice-off checklist in DC snow; mindful checklists require fresh attention each item.

items.q: What should you remember about **Sleep need is retrospective**?
items.a: **Going to bed early for a 4:30 AM flight fails because last night's activity** — not tomorrow's schedule — sets sleep requirement.
